intro.text: A port city in Kerzta, on the northwestern shore of Dayside.

description.text: Although the Dynasty keeps travel under tight control, a local merchant says one or two ships from Darkside put in here every week.

items.text: Duchess Khrissalla's party came ashore here after crossing the Border Ocean from Darkside. They bought supplies from a Kerztian merchant whose signs were in Dynastic and who could speak it.
